title_en: JANUS First Portal — Thin Door to DemiHead and Typed Destinations
title_ru: JANUS Первый Портал — лёгкая Дверь к DemiHead и типизированным направлениям

concept.design_goal: One simple human- and machine-readable entry surface that can discover and route toward bounded JANUS destinations without inheriting their authority or exposing arbitrary network proxy power.
concept.anywhere_semantics: Extensible typed destination catalog, not arbitrary URL forwarding.

historical_evidence.readme: Janus already describes itself as a supporting local/cloud LLM gateway and public metadata hub.
historical_evidence.runtime: janus_core.py already exposes multiple /api routes and provider/model routing, so Portal is a normalization and narrowing of an existing architectural role rather than a newly invented identity.
historical_evidence.important_legacy_boundary: The historical janus_core.py is monolithic and mixes provider routing, memory, narrative/RPG, health prototype, casino/payment/webhook and application routes. It must not be equated with the new thin Portal contract.

security_review_findings.finding: Historical janus_core.py combines unrelated trust domains in one aiohttp application.
security_review_findings.remediation: New Portal must be a separate small contract/module and must not expose legacy casino/health/RPG routes merely because they share the repository.

security_review_findings.finding: Historical core configures wildcard CORS across all registered routes.
security_review_findings.remediation: Reference Portal should have no network listener by default; any future HTTP adapter needs explicit origin allowlisting and separate threat-model review.

security_review_findings.finding: Historical core contains provider secrets/key management and application state in the same process.
security_review_findings.remediation: Portal catalog stores destination metadata only; raw secrets and provider credentials remain outside the route receipt.

security_review_findings.finding: Historical local-model URL is a deployment-specific private-network endpoint embedded in source.
security_review_findings.remediation: Portal destination records use symbolic provider IDs or environment-resolved adapters rather than committed private endpoints.

demihead_critical_front_binding.correction_propagator: Portal may carry a correction-aware route receipt but does not apply evidence corrections itself; DemiHead owns correction propagation semantics.
demihead_critical_front_binding.language_invariance: Portal may carry requested presentation language but must not alter canonical evidence fields; DemiHead language invariance gate validates semantic equality across UA/RU/EN renderings.
demihead_critical_front_binding.disagreement_ledger: Portal may route a review request but cannot convert reviewer disagreement into consensus.
demihead_critical_front_binding.human_appeal: Portal may expose an appeal destination when implemented, but appeal rights and receipts are owned by the destination governance layer.

recommended_implementation_order: Create a deterministic Janus Portal manifest and local route-resolver with zero network side effects.
Add tests proving unknown destinations fail closed and arbitrary URLs are rejected.
Expose DemiHead as an initial typed destination without granting provider/effect authority.
Implement DemiHead Correction Propagator and Language Invariance as separate local gates.
Only later add an HTTP adapter around Portal after authentication, CORS, rate-limit and threat-model review.

established: The existing Janus repository already functions conceptually as a gateway/metadata hub and contains multiple application routes.
A thin typed Portal is a defensible narrowing of that historical role.
The historical monolithic core should not itself be treated as the new constitutional Portal boundary.
not_established: universal connectivity to any external system
automatic permission to use a destination
